chapter: Warren and the Young family show
title: Born in Warren, Arkansas; school band under Professor Parson
summary: Phillips gives his birth year and date, and says a school band under Professor Parson at Myrtle Street School started him on E-flat clarinet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Here we are with Leonard "Phil" Phillips, and we're at Phil's apartment. It's right now January 26, 1983, Wednesday afternoon/early evening, up on 1400 Fairmont Street. We'd like to start at the beginning, Phil. Go back and talk about Arkansas. You wanted to start back then. Tell us about when you were born, your birthday and everything -- you know, family, early roots and all that.
Yeah. I was born in 1907, Warren, Arkansas.

My birthday is the 4th of September. And, in 1921, it was a guy got a band together, a school band, and we started playing like that. His name was Professor Parson. He started us out. We got the band, he started us out in school playing. So I first started playing E-flat clarinet.
What school was that? Do you know the name of the school?
It was Myrtle Street School. He got a band together, we started rehearsing -- that was in 1921. Then in 1924, Lester Young's father came to my home town. He had a show there.
